items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.description: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.

items.title: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
items.description: Western officials stress that any force sent to Ukraine would not take part in any offensive operations.

items.title: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
items.description: The National Transportation Safety Board also believes weather could have been a factor in the crash, but warns it is too early to determine the cause.

items.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
items.description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

items.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
items.description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

items.title: Legal challenge to Australia's social media ban to start in High Court
items.description: A rights group will argue the world-leading policy robs under-16s of their right to free communication.

items.title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
items.description: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.

items.title: Man and boy arrested after allegedly attacking One Nation volunteer with baseball bat in Australia
items.description: The incident comes amid growing calls for the temperature of political debate in Australia to be turned down.

items.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president
items.description: The case, part of the "Farmgate" scandal, has left President Cyril Ramaphosa mired in an impeachment saga.

items.title: Dutch police offer record €2m reward in hunt for drug lord
items.description: Jos Leijdekkers has been found guilty in absentia of cocaine smuggling and is believed to be in Sierra Leone.

items.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
items.description: The move comes barely a week after Rwanda's defence ministry was hit with sanctions by the US Treasury.

items.title: Fake nuclear warning from hacked app sparks unease but not panic in Ukraine
items.description: Many Ukrainians, who have faced years of Russian attacks, did not take the messages seriously and doubted their veracity.
